method: Explicit D005 mappings plus same-name candidates validated against the unchanged full canonical JSON Schema, including conditional requirements. Name equality is not business-semantic proof.
limitation: An incomplete candidate is never emitted as a canonical record. Nested provenance/temporal and quality contracts remain explicit gaps. No source rows, placeholders, defaults or Aspect identifiers were generated.

deferred_mappings.reason: Source date versus canonical date-time; do not invent time-of-day.
Unique event/click and unique person semantics are not proven equivalent.
A literal label is not proof of a registered Aspect definition and version.
